findings.summary: Meta description contains a Swedish spelling error.
findings.consequence: The public Contact page metadata exposes `kontaktforumlär` instead of `kontaktformulär`, so browser previews and SEO snippets can show a misspelled product-facing description.
findings.evidence: The owned SEO metadata sets `description` to `Litteraturbankens kontaktforumlär och utskicksanmälan.`. The relevant SSR and e2e contact tests currently assert the same misspelling, so test coverage preserves the typo instead of detecting it.
findings.recommendation: Change the description to `Litteraturbankens kontaktformulär och utskicksanmälan.` and update the metadata assertions in the contact/about tests.
